changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if exists (select * from sys.objects where name = 'Relationship' and type = 'V' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) begin drop view [dbo].[Relationship] end
changeSet.rollback: create or alter view [dbo].[Relationship] as select R.IntersectTypeID, R.ID as IntersectID, null as Description, '' as [Role], 0 as SourceIntersectTypeNodeID, R.Subject as SourceObjectType, R.SubjectID as SourceObjectID, R.SubjectName as SourceName, '' as SourceParent, 0 as SourceParentID, '' as SourceParentName, R.SubjectTypeID as SourceTypeID, R.SubjectType as SourceType, R.SubjectTypeName as SourceTypeName, R.[SubjectUrl] as SourceUrl, 0 as TargetIntersectTypeNodeID, R.Object as TargetObjectType, R.ObjectID as TargetObjectID, R.ObjectName as TargetName, '' as TargetParent, 0 as TargetParentID, '' as TargetParentName, R.ObjectTypeID as TargetTypeID, R.ObjectType as TargetType, R.ObjectTypeName as TargetTypeName, R.[ObjectUrl] as TargetUrl, TR.[Exists] as HasTechnicalRelationships from IntersectDetail R cross apply ( select case when count(1) > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as [Exists] from [Intersect] where Subject = 'Intersect' and SubjectID = R.ID ) TR
